channel.title: Republic of Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Republic of Congo, every source cited.

item.title: MTN customers report unjustified MoMo withdrawals
item.description: Congolese clients of the South African telecom giant MTN claim their mobile money accounts are being debited without consent.

item.title: AGL Congo raises breast cancer awareness
item.description: Companies including AGL Congo, Congo Terminal, and SAGA Congo held events in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire from October 15-17, 2026.

item.title: Republic of Congo seeks UN Security Council seat
item.description: President Sassou N'Guesso asked African leaders to back the country's bid for a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council for 2030-2031.

item.title: Congo Terminal installs 65 dock fenders at Môle Est
item.description: The rubber and steel buffers protect ships from impact during docking operations at Pointe-Noire port.
